title: Recommendation of halts in Arafah
introduction:
RECOMMENDATION OF HALTS IN ARFAAT

Some deeds are recommended during the halt at Arafaat.

1. Being clean

2. Performing ritual bath. It is better to do so just before the time of Zuhr.

3. Having full focus over Allah. Refrain from those deeds which cause distraction.

4. Halting at the left of 'Jabalur Rahmah'.

5. Halting on a flat land.

6. Perform the Zuhr prayers with one 'Azan' and two Iqaamats'.

7. Recite the recommended supplications and lament before Allah.
